subject: Offer SKU entitlement preflight & co-sell enablement steps
messages:
From: Anna Barlow <anna.barlow@contoso.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@contoso.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: Azure Marketplace - SKU entitlements & co-sell mapping

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the call earlier. We're getting the final list of SKUs together for the RedCloud offering, and I want to align on two things before we start the portal work:

1) SKU entitlement mapping: Contoso needs a single spreadsheet with SKU IDs, metering type (consumption vs. subscription), and the corresponding co-sell entitlements (ISV co-sell, transactable, or none).

2) Publisher identity proofing: our procurement team requires the publisher verification PDF and the tenant verification steps used for co-sell enablement.

I've attached a draft mapping and the current manifest that our listing team keeps. Can you confirm whether Redwood will publish under a shared publisher profile or provide a publisher-to-publisher relationship? That decision affects the offerId and the manifest fields for sellerId/partnerId.

Next steps we expect from Redwood:
- Confirm publisher flow (single Redwood publisher vs. customer-owned publisher)
- Return completed SKU entitlements spreadsheet (attached)
- Provide proof-of-publisher (signed document or portal screenshot)

Can you take the lead on that and loop in whoever owns publisher bootstrapping? We're on a tight timeline to get the offer created before Contoso's quarterly co-sell intake on May 20.

Thanks,
Anna
--
Anna Barlow
Partner Programs, Contoso Cloud

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Anna Barlow <anna.barlow@contoso.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Azure Marketplace - SKU entitlements & co-sell mapping

Anna — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Marissa (partner ops) and Markus (marketplace tech) to cover both the commercial and the manifest pieces.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood will publish the offer under Redwood's publisher profile but we will add Contoso as a co-seller (partner relationship). That keeps the publisher identity stable and simplifies aggregation for telemetry & billing.
- We'll fill out the SKU entitlement spreadsheet and return by Tue morning.
- For proof-of-publisher we can provide both a portal screenshot and a signed publisher attestation PDF (attached).

Marissa / Markus — can you confirm the following runbook items I will need to provide to Contoso:
1) OfferId that we'll reserve (proposed: redwood-redcloud-v1)
2) The manifest.json version we plan to push (we should move to manifest-v2 schema to support per-sku metering)
3) A step-by-step for Contoso to accept co-sell relationship (Azure Partner Center steps + required tenant admin consent)

I'll drop the completed SKU sheet in this thread by EOD Monday. If Seller Support needs escalation for identity or offer bootstrap, I will open a ticket and include the Contoso contacts.

—Sean

Attachments referenced: publisher-id-proof.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Azure Marketplace - SKU entitlements & co-sell mapping

Team — technical notes: please see inline answers and the attached SKU entitlement template (sku-entitlement-mapping.xlsx).

- OfferId and Publisher model: agree with Sean on Redwood-publisher-first approach. Proposed canonical OfferId: redwood-redcloud-v1. We should reserve via Partner Center now to avoid conflicts.

- Manifest details: we must use the manifest-v2 schema. Key fields Contoso will need to populate for each SKU are skuId, planId (if subscription), meterType (billingMeter, subscription), and the coSell flag (true/false). Example snippet I pasted below for their engineer: 

  "sku": {
    "id": "redcloud-standard",
    "metering": "billingMeter",
    "coSell": true
  }

- Entitlement mapping: Contoso's procurement asks that the coSell entitlement column matches Microsoft's allowed values (ISVCoSell, Transactable, None). We'll translate their labels on return.

- Identity proofing: we need Contoso to provide either:
  * a portal screenshot showing Contoso tenant as collaborator under our publisher (they must be invited and accept), or
  * the signed publisher attestation PDF.

Action items (Marissa): please draft the partner onboarding checklist we'll send to Contoso, and add the link to the Redwood internal doc for manifest publishing. I will start the Partner Center offer reservation and capture the reservation id.

-Markus

Attachments referenced: sku-entitlement-mapping.xlsx, manifest-v2.json

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Barlow <anna.barlow@contoso.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Azure Seller Support <seller-support@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Azure Marketplace - SKU entitlements & co-sell mapping

Hi Anna — appreciate the quick replies here. Attaching the completed SKU entitlement mapping and the manifest stub for your engineering team. A few operational notes and next steps: 

1) I've reserved the OfferId in Partner Center: redwood-redcloud-v1 (reservation id: PC-RES-45219). Please reference that in any portal requests.
2) Seller Support contact looped to pre-approve identity verification flow. Azure Seller Support, can you confirm whether the shared publisher + co-seller relationship requires additional paperwork beyond the signed attestation?
3) Contoso: please confirm whether any SKUs are meant to be transactable (marketplace handles payment) vs. meter-billed (Redwood invoices). We left a column blank where you should mark Transactable/Invoice/Subscription.

Deliverables attached to this thread:
- sku-entitlement-mapping.xlsx (completed where we had clarity)
- manifest-v2.json (stub with sample sku block)
- publisher-id-proof.pdf (signed attestation)

If Contoso can accept these and return the completed columns by EOD Thursday (May 14), we will publish the offer to staging by next week and request co-sell enablement in parallel. If Seller Support needs escalation, I will file a formal support request and share the case id here.

Thanks,
Marissa
Partner & Marketplace Operations
--
Marissa Cole
Redwood Inference
